contexts.text: The flight () = the last time; also that of every man when he dies.
That the Lord put to flight evils and falsities. Signified.
The Lord continually, so far as possible, puts evils and falsities to flight, but by means of conscience.

Pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, nor on a Sabbath () = removal from (the good of love and from the good of innocence), lest this should take place precipitately in a state of too much cold, or in a state of too much heat; flight = a removal from a state of the good of love and of innocence; flight in the winter = removal from them in a state of too much cold = there is cold when there is aversion for these things, which is induced by the loves of self; flight on a sabbath = removal from them in a state of too much heat; heat = a holy external when there is the love of self and of the world within.
Power in the spiritual sense is to put to flight... the infernal crew, which is done solely by means of truths. (Compare AC 364:end.)
The flight and damnation of falsities. Signified.
The flight of falsities from evils. Signified. To drive out = to put to flight, thus flight.
No hurried flight or removal of the falsities and evils which are signified by the nations in the Land of Canaan. Signified.
